body.x: Incipio(www.incipio.com) announced water resistant bluetooth speaker 'Braven BRV-1' at the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

'Braven BRV-1' is resistant to rainfall, water jets, and water splashing(IPX5 Water Resistant), and the 1400Ah battery enables to play wireless audio for up to 12hours which has a button to indicate how much battery life is left. Also, lanyard is included to attach the BRV-1 for travel.

CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
